All unprinted spaces including within the device are transparent. Shade through fine separate hatch lines only. Flat lighting, no cast shadows, no paper texture or background. No realistic product render, no ingredient-icon illustration, no soft painterly colour, no modern generic font.
Composition: centered complete design with breathing room, all flourishes and edges inside the canvas. Strong typographic hierarchy and a recognisable silhouette. One design only.
